name: session-tracker
description: Shows every Claude session on this machine with the repository, worktree and branch it works in, and flags branches and worktrees that hold unpushed work or can be cleaned up.

showRow.title: Row above the prompt
showRow.description: Shows one line above the prompt with the counts and buttons to open the panel.

days.title: Sessions from the last (days)
days.description: How far back sessions are listed. A repository is tracked when a session in this window worked in it.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the panel reads sessions and git again while it is open. With only the row above the prompt showing, it reads six times slower. 0 reads only when you ask.

staleDays.title: Idle after (days)
staleDays.description: A worktree with uncommitted changes, or with no session, is flagged once it has been untouched this long.

extraRepos.title: More repositories
extraRepos.description: Optional. Folders of repositories to track even when no recent session worked there, separated by semicolons.
